messages:
anna_release: Heads-up — patch rollout for summarizer v2.3.1 scheduled in ~10m (change window). Preflight eval flagged a regression on the 'legal-summarize' prompt set. We need a quick decision: pin or proceed?
jen_qa: Posted the diffs — avg rouge -0.7%, hallucination score +2.1%. safety-halluc check tripped. Not a clear pass.
deploy-bot: preflight-eval job #4821 finished — RESULT: FAILED. summary: quality_delta=-0.007; hallucination_up=0.021; blocked_checks=[safety-halluc, intent-preservation]. logs: https://ci.redwood/job/4821
mike_sre: If we freeze canary now we can pin model to v2.3.0 for sensitive routes and avoid user impact. How fast can ops apply pin?
lee_ops: We can pin in <2m for route rules, but changing routing during change window needs release approval. Also not great to change eval set midflight.
anna_release: Proposal: 1) pause canary rollout (freeze), 2) pin summarizer -> v2.3.0 for /summarize/legal and /summarize/finance routes, 3) queue a bisect job on the failing prompt set and open a tracking bug. Any objections?
jen_qa: +1 to hold & pin. We should also require manual QA signoff before unfreezing.
mike_sre: I'll run a targeted smoke with the pinned config and re-run preflight (#4822). ETA ~5m.
deploy-bot: action: canary-rollout PAUSED by @anna_release. action: model-pin applied — summarizer pinned to v2.3.0 on routes [/summarize/legal, /summarize/finance] by @anna_release. preflight rerun queued (job #4822).
anna_release: Thanks team. I'll update release notes and the change window notice: "Hold: canary paused, model pinned for sensitive routes; investigating preflight regression." pinging @sales @support to prep comms. :eyes:
